spec_match.rationale: Runs the real Iterator.prototype.join (native on this 153 build — the banner read Native) over real helper pipelines, with the pulled-values counter proving the no-intermediate-array contract.

interactive.rationale: Count/stop/separator/pipeline-shape controls all re-run the join live; facts tiles and result update (verified).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises native-or-labelled-shim and the work it took — both present, and on this build the native path runs.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the filter-pulls-past-rejects case, source-exhausted case, and the no-helpers-at-all browser branch.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes 7/7 on this build, asserting the method surface and its Array.prototype.join-parity semantics.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Native join exercised with multiple shapes; laziness visible (pulled < available when take cuts short); console clean, both viewports clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: pipeline-joined asserts the literal true; asserting result-length consistency (e.g. pulled >= values joined) would be falsifiable.

design_system.rationale: Banner/facts/result styling all variable-based; native banner uses emerald on stone within AA.

accessibility.rationale: All four controls labelled, result pre focusable (tabindex 0), aria-live detail, visible focus 12/12.

openQuestions.title: Update the 'enabling it now' index copy — join/zip/zipKeyed are native in this 153 build
openQuestions.detail: The feature index still describes Chrome 150 with --js-flags=--harmony as the only way to get the methods. On Chromium 153.0.8010.12 with no flags, Iterator.prototype.join is native (this page's banner reads Native and the suite passes 7/7). Refresh the index section to record the shipped state, keeping the 150 measurement as history. Same applies to the joint-iteration index.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. Native join confirmed on this milestone's own build; the demo's laziness counter is the strongest part. Index enabling-copy is now stale.
